title: New session
subtitle: Save a training run without opening the vehicle sheet.

circuit.title: Where did you run?
circuit.hint: Defaults to the last circuit you used, or the first in your list. If the last car is still in your garage, you skip ahead to times.
circuit.emptyHint: Create a minimal one so you can save the session. A name is enough.
circuit.name: Name

vehicle.title: Which car did you use?
vehicle.hint: Defaults to the last car used in session mode if it is still in your garage.
vehicle.emptyHint: Add a car or pick a catalogue reference. You can do that now and come back later; nothing is saved as a draft.

capture.title: Session times
capture.subtitle: {{vehicle}} · {{circuit}}
capture.totalTooLow: Total time ({{total}}) is below the minimum ({{minimum}}) for {{laps}} laps with a best lap of {{bestLap}}
capture.required: Fill in best lap, total time and laps.
capture.invalidBest: Best lap is not a valid time (mm:ss.mmm).
capture.invalidTotal: Total time is not a valid time (mm:ss.mmm).
capture.invalidLaps: Laps must be a whole number greater than 0.
capture.invalidVoltage: Voltage must be between 0 and 30 V.

summary.title: Session saved
summary.saved: The time now appears on the vehicle sheet and in the Timings list.
summary.anotherHint: Same circuit and same car. Only the times are cleared.
